controls.name: finding_custody
controls.requirement: Preserve the exact finding, recommendation, evidence boundary, date, and authority.

controls.name: recipient_custody
controls.requirement: Name every recipient, duty holder, and distributed author.

controls.name: response_publication_state
controls.requirement: Distinguish response due, received, publicly recoverable, and absent.

controls.name: implementation_owner
controls.requirement: Name the person or body accountable for each operative change.

controls.name: deadline_and_reopen
controls.requirement: Fix implementation deadlines, overdue states, and automatic reopen triggers.

controls.name: baseline_preservation
controls.requirement: Preserve the prechange process, rates, exceptions, and failure evidence.

controls.name: live_process_specification
controls.requirement: Specify the actual notice, support, welfare, restriction, review, and safety-handoff changes.

controls.name: training_deployment_receipt
controls.requirement: Record who was trained, when, on what version, and with what competence check.

controls.name: worker_and_record_repair
controls.requirement: Identify affected people and repair access, duties, pay, records, or explanations where warranted.

controls.name: independent_verification
controls.requirement: Use evidence independent of the implementing organization to test operation.

controls.name: challenge_and_collective_access
controls.requirement: Keep worker, representative, and pattern-level challenge channels operational.

controls.name: recurrence_review
controls.requirement: Test recurrence, drift, exceptions, and repeated concerns against the original finding.

controls.name: missing_population_inclusion
controls.requirement: Include exited, silent, deterred, restored, appealed, and externally observed outcomes.

controls.name: residual_harm_publication
controls.requirement: Publish unresolved gaps and foreseeable failure modes rather than declaring blanket closure.

controls.name: closure_review
controls.requirement: Require independent review before a prevention claim is marked closed.

controls.name: future_control_revision
controls.requirement: Change the operative control and validation target when later evidence contradicts the response.

non_entitlements: A response receipt does not establish compliance or prevention.
An announced policy does not prove operation.
Training completion does not prove competence or changed decisions.
A prevention audit does not decide legal liability or individual culpability.
Later evidence does not create retroactive entitlement in a separate employment decision.
